_about: Hand-transcribed from pdftotext -layout output of the cited pages. pdf_page is the 1-based PDF page. Values are as printed; nothing is derived.

spd_ac_finder.note: Type 2, 230/400 V systems; 3-pole 7P.23 is L1-L2-L3 to PEN, 4-pole 7P.25 is L1-L2-L3-N to PE. Uc, In and Imax are the L-PEN / L,N-PE columns for the 275 V module.

spd_ac_dehn_3p.note: DEHNguard M WE ...: modular surge arrester (3+0 configuration) with a rated varistor voltage Umov 750 V a.c. (catalogue p.63, pdf p.65); listed for TN-C systems, one unit per installation, in the selection chart for industrial buildings (catalogue p.50, pdf p.52).

spd_ac_dehn_it.note: DEHNguard SE H 1000 FM: pluggable single-pole type 2 arrester 'specifically designed for higher system voltages' (catalogue p.68, pdf p.70). Three units, one from each phase conductor to PE, make the '3 - 0' circuit the DEHN Lightning Protection Guide (DS702/E 2014, printed p.233, Figure 8.1.5.2a) shows for IT systems without a distributed neutral, where the phase-to-PE Uc must be >= 1.1 x U(L-L).

it_requirement.text: Phase conductor to PE: Uc >= 1.1 x U L-L
it_requirement.context: page233.html (printed p.232): after the first fault in an IT system the voltage of the intact conductors to earth corresponds to the voltage between the phase conductors

pt_33kv.product: WBSEDCL specification for a 33 kV outdoor single-phase oil-filled potential transformer

la_36kv_counter.product: Buyer technical specification, switchgear surge arresters, 36 kV class (issuer not named in the document)
la_36kv_counter.counter: self-contained discharge counter with leakage current meter on each single-pole unit (clause 4.0 (j), (k))
